description: Read entities from the KB with exact filters, or ask typed fact questions. Use for lookup by id, type, tags or sourceFile, and for precise questions about modeled facts: predicate facts by name with named arguments (predicate + where), property facts of a subject (subjectKey + propertyKey), the domain view of a subject (factKind 'subject' + subjectKey: its definition, broader and narrower subjects, every current requirement about it and the claims and scenarios on it), or the catalog of facts of one kind (factKind; 'predicate_schema' lists the predicates you can ask about with their argument names and constants). Typed answers return matching fact rows plus factQuery: the schema used, distinct counts, values that do exist when nothing matched, warnings about the question and the next call to make. Read-only. Tags filter by metadata tags only, not entity IDs.

args.description: Positional argument values for a predicate with no schema; null matches any. Prefer where.

distinct.description: Optional argument name whose distinct values to count across the matching predicate facts.

factKind.description: Typed fact filter: list facts of one kind; 'predicate_schema' returns the catalog of askable predicates.

id.description: Optional exact entity ID. Example: 'REQ-cli-gc'. If omitted, returns matching entities by other filters.

includeBody.description: With id only: also return the entity's authored Markdown body. Default: false.

kb.description: Optional KB dependency name from .kb/dependencies.json to read, at its pinned commit, instead of this project's KB.

limit.description: Optional max rows to return after filtering. Default: 100 when omitted. Example: 25.

namespace.description: Optional predicate namespace when the same name exists in several. Default: any namespace.

offset.description: Optional zero-based pagination offset. Default: 0. Example: 50 to skip first 50 rows.

polarity.description: Optional polarity filter for predicate facts. Default: both.

predicate.description: Typed fact filter: predicate name to ask about; returns its stored facts with arguments, polarity and effect.

propertyKey.description: Optional property key under subjectKey, e.g. 'max_roles'. Returns operator, value and unit of each fact.

scope.description: Optional: 'current_requirements' keeps only facts a current (not superseded or retired) requirement requires.

sourceFile.description: Optional source-file substring filter. Example: 'src/auth/login.ts'. Uses KB source linkage, not file-system scanning.

subjectKey.description: Typed fact filter: dotted subject key whose property facts to list; combine with propertyKey or factKind 'subject'.

tags.description: Optional tag filter. Matches entities that contain any provided tag. Example: ['security','billing'].

type.description: Optional entity type filter. Allowed: req, scenario, test, adr, flag, event, symbol, fact. Example: 'req'.

where.description: Named argument values for predicate, using the names from its schema.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

name: kb_query
